summary: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the pricing of $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 7.250% Series A Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057, issued under a shelf registration statement. The notes are unsecured junior subordinated obligations, fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a subordinated unsecured basis by Alexandria Real Estate Equities, L.P. Underwriters include J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and RBC. Delivery is expected on or about August 21, 2026. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation; no equity component, no premium, no risk-arb angle.
